nameJa: 左側のチャットとコーラル
conceptNote: 黒い動画の左側に明るいチャットを重ね、画面内で位置を変えられる関係を示す。
prompt:
OUTPUT IMAGE: 1760 pixels wide, 1120 pixels high; 11:7 near-square landscape artboard, NOT a panorama. Leave substantial blank margins ABOVE AND BELOW the video rectangle.
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE standalone refined text-free explanatory Chrome extension promo diagram. Landscape 11:7 ratio, target 1760 x 1120 pixels. It must instantly communicate FULLSCREEN VIDEO WITH LIVE CHAT OVERLAID INSIDE.
Editorial modern flat vector-like composition, coral background around one oversized ink-charcoal video canvas. The video canvas is a single coherent rounded rectangle centered on the artboard with generous coral margin. FOUR bold off-white L-shaped fullscreen corner marks are INSIDE the FOUR OUTERMOST CORNERS of this full video canvas, spanning both video and chat. They must enclose the ENTIRE rectangle and ALL of the chat. Video is one single charcoal field extending behind the chat.
Distinctive composition: a light warm cream CHAT OVERLAY floats INSIDE THE LEFT side of the charcoal fullscreen video, occupying 26% video width and 68% height, with comfortable gaps from all frame edges and corner symbols. Three or four chat rows, each a small coral or dark avatar circle followed by one or two crisp dark horizontal strokes. Bottom of chat a quiet outlined composer with a tiny send triangle icon. No actual words: all message content only geometric line bars. On the spacious right two-thirds video field a single large off-white play triangle inside a very thin off-white circle. Empty flat charcoal video background, no scene. Clear overlay spatial relationship, sophisticated whitespace, matte coral/cream/charcoal palette, calm asymmetric balance.
All UI content remains within the single fullscreen video boundary. NO separate sidebar, no second screen, no phone, no physical monitor. No words, letters, digits, symbols resembling language, logo, title, watermark or captions. No human or landscape, no gradients, no lighting, no 3D, no glow, no decorative clutter. Bold readable diagram at 440 x 280 pixels.
